Name: Harder Gift Tastes for Content Patcher
Author: Jinglefox
Description:
Removes almost every universal like and neutral in the game while also shifting nearly everything that isn't cooked to liked and nearly everything that was liked to neutral. The goal of this mod is to force the player to both cook food and slow their heart progress. A full changelog might come at some point, I'll have to look into that.

Please feel free to leave feedback, I haven't done any balance testing for this yet. Year two or three seems like a reasonable expectation for hitting 10 hearts with most of the villagers.
